newsitem.title: USA: Marvel denies involvement in Toy Biz move.
newsitem.headline: Marvel denies involvement in Toy Biz move.

text.p: Marvel Entertainment Group Inc denied that it was behind Toy Biz Inc's decision to withdraw from a joint reorganization of the bankrupt comic book maker.
"This is a sour grapes PR (public relations) spin from bondholders," a Marvel spokesman said.

A spokesman for the bondholders said that Ronald Perelman, who controlled 80 percent of Marvel before the bankruptcy filing, pressured Toy Biz to withdraw from a bondholder-backed plan to bring Marvel out of bankruptcy.

The reorganization of Marvel, which owns a stake in Toy Biz, has not yet involved Toy Biz's board, since there was no Toy Biz board meeting to consider a proposed term sheet of the reorganization, the Marvel spokesman said.
"The notion that any pressure was brought to bear on the Toy Biz board was absolutely and categorically false," the Marvel spokesman said
Marvel's position is that the company holds an auction to get the best and highest bidder for the company "to ensure the maximum recovery of all parties of interest, the Marvel spokesman said.
